subject: Request: 3yr Anchored Rate + Uplift Cap for Brightline Health
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlinehealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-year pricing ask

Diego —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and our finance team reviewed the renewal economics and we have one final ask to move forward: a 3-year rate anchor on the per-token price with a 10% uplift cap year-over-year and a renewal-protection clause that prevents unilateral price increases beyond the cap for renewals tied to the same committed seats.

We can sign a 36-month commitment at current usage levels if Redwood can lock pricing within those terms and add the renewal protection language in the SOW. Can you confirm whether Redwood is open to that? If not, what is the nearest alternative you can offer?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
CFO, Brightline Health
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-year pricing ask

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity and the commitment signal. Looping in Marissa (AE) to scope the exact SOW language and legal implications. Short answer: we typically support price protection on committed term deals but need exec approval for a fixed 3-year anchor with a 10% uplift cap — that’s outside standard guardrails. I’ll pull together the ask, proposed trade-offs, and a recommended approval path.

Can you share expected committed spend profile (monthly burn / annualized) so we can model unit economics?

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Multi-year pricing ask — initial proposal

Diego / Rishi —

Summary of the ask from Brightline: 3yr anchored per-token price, 10% uplift cap YOY, renewal-protection clause, 36-month commitment at current usage. Attachments: SOW draft + pricing model.

My recommended structure to make this OK from a risk/cost perspective:
- Upfront commit: 60% of year 1 estimated spend, paid on signature (reduces revenue volatility)
- Annual true-up: reconciliation each year with a 6-month notice window for adjustments
- Uplift cap: accept 10% cap, but floor at +3% (to preserve minimum inflation adjustments) and require a minimum annual usage threshold to qualify for the anchor
- Early termination: pro-rated refund only after year 2 + 90-day notice, break fee applies in year 1

If leadership signs off on the uplift band (+3% floor / +10% cap) plus upfront commit, I think we can accept renewal-protection language limited to identical seat counts and usage profile. Need Rishi or Lauren approval on pricing exception and legal redlines on SOW.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Multi-year pricing ask — initial proposal

Team —

Reviewed the modeling (pricing_model_3yr.xlsx). Key concerns:
1) 10% uplift cap with no floor exposes us to negative margin if model improvements drive higher compute spend per token on their workload.
2) The proposed 60% upfront payment mitigates cash risk but we need to tie the discount level to committed spend bands.

Proposed approval terms for exec sign-off:
- Approve anchored rate for 36 months with uplift band +3% / +10%
- Require 60% upfront payment on signature and annual true-up
- Approval scoped to Brightline only, non-transferable, and contingent on SOC2 evidence (procurement asked)
- Discount band cap: total ACV discount not to exceed 25% of list in year 1 (anything beyond requires VP-level approval)

If Leadership buys this structure, I’ll draft the specific approval memo.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request: Brightline 3yr anchor — package for Diego

Team —

Putting together for Exec review. TL;DR recommendation: grant limited exception to standard pricing guardrails with following constraints:
- 3-year anchored rate with uplift band +3% floor / +10% cap YOY
- 60% of year 1 committed spend due at signature; annual true-up thereafter
- Renewal-protection clause limited to same seat counts and usage tier; any >15% step-change in usage triggers re-negotiation
- Total discount in year 1 capped at 22% (under Rishi threshold to avoid VP escalation)
- Contingent on delivery of SOC2 report and procurement-approved SOW language

Please approve or escalate to VP/Sales leadership. If approved, Diego — send the attached SOW with the marked-up language and request Alex execute the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr Anchored Rate + Uplift Cap for Brightline Health

Alex —

Good news: Leadership has approved a limited exception. Terms we can offer (summary):
- 3yr anchored per-token rate with uplift band of +3% (floor) to +10% (cap) year-over-year
- 60% of Year 1 committed spend due upon signature; annual true-up and reconciliation
- Renewal-protection clause tied to identical seat counts and usage tier; any >15% usage step-change or material product change triggers re-open
- Year 1 total discount capped at 22% of list price

Next steps: I’ve attached the SOW with the marked redlines and the pricing workbook. If this is acceptable, please sign the DocuSign link and wire the upfront. We can schedule a short legal call to walk the SOW redlines if needed.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to a solid three-year relationship.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Brightline_v3.pdf (SOW draft with redlines); pricing_model_3yr.xlsx (model).
